title: Puppy Boarding in Miramar, FL: What to Know Before Your Trip
meta: Puppy boarding in Miramar, FL at Four Paws Inn. Cage free home boarding, $80 a day for puppies, outside to play every hour, daily photo and video updates. 230+ Google reviews, 4.9 stars.
body: Leaving a puppy for the first time is hard. You want to know they will be watched, played with, and kept on their routine. Here is how puppy boarding works at Four Paws Inn in Miramar.
## What your puppy's day looks like
Your puppy stays in our family home, not a kennel. Dogs go outside to play every hour. Puppies meet other dogs slowly, matched by size and energy. When they need a nap, they get a quiet spot to rest.
## Keep the routine
Tell us when your puppy eats, naps, and goes to bed. Pack their food, one meal per Ziploc bag, so every meal is the same food they eat at home.
## What to bring
Their food, their leash, and any medicine they take. Vaccines must be current. We have beds, bowls and toys.
## Price
Puppies are $80 a day. A second dog gets $5 a day off. Pick up before 10 AM and your last day is free. A 25% deposit holds your dates.
## You will see how they are doing
You get daily photo and video updates, so you can enjoy your trip.
## Ready to book?
Send us your dates and tell us about your puppy. Call or text (754) 277 2325, or book at fourpawsinn.co. Four Paws Inn has 230+ Google reviews and a 4.9 star rating.

title: Dog Boarding Near Pembroke Pines and Southwest Ranches

body: If you live in Pembroke Pines or Southwest Ranches, Four Paws Inn is right next door in west Miramar. We are a family run, cage free home for dogs.
## Where we are
1700 SW 137th Way, Miramar, FL 33027. We serve families in Pembroke Pines, Southwest Ranches, Weston, Cooper City and Davie.
## Your dog's stay

Your dog stays in our home, not a kennel. Dogs go outside to play every hour, in small groups matched by size and energy. Dogs who like the water get supervised pool time. You get daily photo and video updates.
## Prices
$60 a day under 50 lb. $75 a day over 50 lb. $80 a day for puppies and seniors. $5 a day off a second dog. Pick up before 10 AM and your last day is free.
## How to book
Fill out our guest form, sign the boarding agreement we email you, and pay a 25% deposit to hold your dates. The rest is due at drop off.
## Drop off and pick up
7 days a week, 9 AM to 12 PM or 4 PM to 6:30 PM. Text us when you arrive and we meet you at your car.
## Ready to book?
Send us your dates and tell us about your dog. Call or text (754) 277 2325, or book at fourpawsinn.co.
